content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery post-crypto payment is a sophisticated infrastructure approach that eliminates reliance on conventional payment processors. Instead of facing high fees like those from Gumroad, which can take up to 10% per sale, creators can utilize NOWPayments with only a 0.5% fee. This difference can dramatically enhance profitability, allowing creators to retain more revenue and invest back into their work, which is crucial in highly competitive digital markets.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture leverages a combination of free-tier hosting services, backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and crypto payment processing through NOWPayments. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is instantly verified on-chain, triggering automated delivery of the ebook or digital product. This real-time interaction ensures that creators can focus on their content while the infrastructure handles transactions and delivery seamlessly.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Gumroad charges 10% per sale; NOWPayments only 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components of this architecture include Cloudflare Pages for hosting your site, NOWPayments for accepting crypto payments, and Google Drive for storing and delivering your products. This integration ensures a streamlined process where each element works in harmony to provide a robust solution. The choice of free tools also lowers the barrier to entry, making it accessible for creators from various backgrounds without significant upfront costs.

Follow the provided documentation to set up your hosting, payment processing, and product delivery. With 30 days of support included, you'll have the guidance necessary to navigate any challenges during deployment, ensuring your ecommerce site is operational quickly and efficiently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure. This solution allows you to process payments through cryptocurrencies via NOWPayments, ensuring automated delivery of your products without high platform fees. By implementing tools like Cloudflare and Google Drive, you maintain control over your sales and customer interactions.

This kit provides all necessary blueprints and templates to ensure your success. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

You can sell ebooks without platform fees by using a sovereign digital commerce stack. By leveraging low-cost tools and accepting payments in cryptocurrency, you can significantly reduce transaction fees and keep more of your earnings.

For automated delivery, you'll need a hosting service like Cloudflare Pages, payment processing through NOWPayments, and a storage solution such as Google Drive. These components work together to ensure a smooth transaction and delivery process.

Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies for transactions. This flexibility allows you to cater to a diverse audience and provide more payment options to your customers.
Can I manage everything myself?
Absolutely. The infrastructure is designed for you to own and manage everything without external dependencies. This sovereignty means you control your sales, customer data, and product delivery.
